/: Storage Center home — capacity, job health, backend status, and shortcuts into volumes and protection.
/volumes: Intent-backed volume inventory across registered storage backends.
/rbd: Ceph RBD image inventory when the Ceph driver is active.
/snapshots: Volume and image snapshots for point-in-time recovery.
/backups: Backup jobs and restore entry points for protected volumes.
/buckets: Object / RGW bucket inventory and lifecycle.
/observatory: Cross-cutting health and capacity observatory for the storage plane.
/activity: Recent storage activity feed (provisions, deletes, migrations).
/alerts: Storage and backend alerts requiring operator attention.
/metrics-dashboard: Metrics dashboards for pools, devices, and gateway latency.
/jobs: Durable async jobs from every mutating Atlas API call.
/audit: Audit log of storage control-plane actions (exportable).
/access: Tokens, roles, and API access for Storage Center and clients.
/policies: Storage intent policies (production, database, development, shared, ai).
/databridge/sources: Cloud / external database sources for DataBridge migrations.
/databridge/plans/:id: Single migration plan detail — stages, validation, and cutover.
/databridge/edge-clusters: Edge database clusters managed through DataBridge.
/databridge/replication: Ongoing replication links for DataBridge workloads.
/backends: Registered StorageDriver backends (Ceph first; NFS/ZFS/etc. as added).
/kubernetes: Kubernetes StorageClass / CSI integration status for Atlas.
/cluster: Atlas gateway cluster / HA membership view.
/ceph: Ceph-specific day-2 operations (OSD, pool, RGW health).
/maintenance: Maintenance windows and safe ops against storage backends.
/dr: Disaster recovery plans and failover for Atlas-managed data.
